exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

cryptographic signatures whispering through trusted links
voices from hacker public radio on the fringe
partly cloudy summer afternoon in san francisco
fog bank sitting offshore waiting for evening

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Drag your thumb across a fogged glass pane to reveal hidden constellations before sunset; each clear stroke exposes more sky but burns daylight faster.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: satisfying peel-back as patterns emerge through the mist
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: less time per swipe as the sun sinks toward the horizon

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Swipe incoming link packets left or right into trusted and untrusted bins by matching their cryptographic signature shapes before the queue overflows.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: snap verdicts with a crisp lock-in click on each correct sort
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: signatures grow noisier and packets arrive in tighter bursts

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Tap to launch tiny agents carrying code fragments across a pre-dawn skyline; stagger their departures so every agent reaches the ship dock before sunrise breaks.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: orchestrating parallel agents on one screen feels like conducting a launch
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more agents spawn with overlapping timing windows each wave

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick a pocket radio dial through static to find ghost broadcasts from 2026; hold the sweet spot to decode fragmented future headlines before interference pulls you off frequency.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each locked frequency unlocks a cryptic snippet from tomorrow
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: interference spikes and dial drift increase with every decode
